No extrapolation from finite tests to the universal theorem.

value.rationale: The scientifically motivated object is recurrent heat-stress recovery when two physiologically distinct memories can act in opposite directions. The precise question of whether mean and variance of return gaps suffice is answered negatively by a strictly positive, exact, equal-moment pair with opposing expected vulnerability; this is not a renaming or single negative sign check. A universal convex-order sign frontier additionally pinpoints when variability’s impact must change as average recovery duration grows. The result is a modest self-contained theoretical boundary useful as a benchmark for uncertainty-aware ecological models, not a field prediction or downstream management theorem.
